metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.1 · 2007 · Transformers
metas.description: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 2009 · Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
metas.description: Sam Witwicky leaves the Autobots behind for a normal life. But when his mind is filled with cryptic symbols, the Decepticons target him and he is dragged back into the Transformers' war.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2011 · Transformers: Dark of the Moon
metas.description: The Autobots learn of a Cybertronian spacecraft hidden on the moon, and race against the Decepticons to reach it and to learn its secrets.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.6 · 2014 · Transformers: Age of Extinction
metas.description: When humanity allies with a bounty hunter in pursuit of Optimus Prime, the Autobots turn to a mechanic and his family for help.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.2 · 2017 · Transformers: The Last Knight
metas.description: A deadly threat from Earth's history reappears and a hunt for a lost artifact takes place between Autobots and Decepticons, while Optimus Prime encounters his creator in space.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.7 · 2018 · Bumblebee
metas.description: Bumblebee teams up with a teenage girl to protect the world while the Decepticons hunt him with the help of a secret agency.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.0 · 2023 · Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
metas.description: During the '90s, a new faction of Transformers - the Maximals - join the Autobots as allies in the battle for Earth.
